problem_text:
A logistics company must select packages to load onto a cargo drone. Available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 9 cubic feet, revenue $247
* Package 2: volume 41 cubic feet, revenue $189
* Package 3: volume 33 cubic feet, revenue $76
* Package 4: volume 5 cubic feet, revenue $245
* Package 5: volume 26 cubic feet, revenue $256
* Package 6: volume 21 cubic feet, revenue $169
* Package 7: volume 31 cubic feet, revenue $82
* Package 8: volume 19 cubic feet, revenue $33
* Package 9: volume 27 cubic feet, revenue $43
* Package 10: volume 30 cubic feet, revenue $100
* Package 11: volume 5 cubic feet, revenue $67
* Package 12: volume 26 cubic feet, revenue $128
* Package 13: volume 19 cubic feet, revenue $64
* Package 14: volume 28 cubic feet, revenue $161
* Package 15: volume 35 cubic feet, revenue $25
* Package 16: volume 37 cubic feet, revenue $35
* Package 17: volume 26 cubic feet, revenue $221
* Package 18: volume 34 cubic feet, revenue $198
* Package 19: volume 15 cubic feet, revenue $135
* Package 20: volume 11 cubic feet, revenue $65
* Package 21: volume 8 cubic feet, revenue $284
* Package 22: volume 39 cubic feet, revenue $84
The drone's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 367 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
